titleEn: Birthday Wish — To My Soul Friend (The One Tamil Kavithai 🌟)
linesEn: Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜,
Every day you smile
is a celebration for me too.
May each of your dreams
bloom gently and beautifully;
may your heart always
be filled with calm and peace;
may the love you give so freely
return to you a hundredfold.
Happy Birthday,
my dearest soul friend 💜
Some people don't just walk into your life,
they make life itself beautiful.
Since you arrived,
even our simplest, quietest days
turn into little celebrations.
Without weighing my thoughts,
without questioning my silences,
you accept me just as I am.
In your presence,
I never have to pretend —
I always feel like I've come home.
One minute a song,
the next deep philosophy,
the next a burst of silly laughter with no reason at all.
From crazy thoughts to secret dreams,
even after hours of talking,
there is still a million things left to say.
Maybe that's the magic between us:
a conversation that never has an ending.

titleEn: The Last Bite of Ice Cream
linesEn: They say true friendship is measured in the little things:
The quiet ear when my mind gets too loud,
the inside jokes nobody else will ever understand,
and the laughter that doubles just because we're together.
I would even share my last bite of the ice cream with you,
Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜.
"Thank you" is far too small a word
to hold what your presence truly means.
The warmth you give without even trying,
the light you bring into every room,
all of it together makes my world so much brighter.
I'm so lucky to have you in my life, babe ✨
